objectives: Shop for food with quantities and ask and give prices in euros.
Say numbers to 1,000, ages, phone numbers and clock times.
Present close family members with names, ages and where they live.
Describe today's weather and give a simple forecast.

teacherNote.title: Plan one picnic, one detail at a time
teacherNote.body: This is a big lesson, so use one practical scene: plan a picnic, check the shopping, choose a time and look at the weather. Family is your main speaking task.

dialogue.title: A picnic plan

hero.title: Ska vi ha picknick?
hero.lede: Make a shopping list and choose a time. Introduce your family, then invite a friend with all the details they need.

speakers.name: Elin
speakers.fi: Ska vi ha picknick i Brunnsparken på lördag?

hero.encounterLabel: Elin and Alex plan the food, the time and the weather for a picnic in Helsinki

lines.en: Lena and Andreas have two sons, Nils and Jonas, who go to comprehensive school. Andreas's parents are their paternal grandparents (farmor and farfar). Lena's parents are their maternal grandparents (mormor and morfar). They are very old, about 70 (seventy).

sections.title: Food, quantities and prices
body: Put the quantity straight before the food. Swedish has no word for 'of': en påse godis, två kilo mjöl, tre paket mjölk. Hindi works the same way (do kilo aloo), so copy Hindi here, not English.
Foods you count take a plural: sex bananer, elva potatisar. Foods you weigh or pour stay singular: ett kilo potatis, fyra hekto svamp, tre flaskor juice. Ett hekto is 100 grams.
Ask the price with Vad kostar …? or Hur mycket kostar …? Say 3,50 € as tre euro och femtio cent, or in quick speech tre och femtio. At the counter, Kan jag få …? is a polite way to ask for something.

examples.fi: Kan jag få fyra hekto ost, tack?
examples.en: Can I have 400 grams of cheese, please?
examples.note: Polite and natural at a cheese or meat counter.

examples.fi: Hur mycket kostar en liter jordgubbar? Fem euro.
examples.en: How much is a litre of strawberries? Five euros.
examples.note: At Finnish market squares, berries are often sold by the litre.

examples.fi: Hur mycket blir det? Det blir tolv euro och femtio cent.
examples.en: How much is that? That's twelve euros fifty.
examples.note: Hur mycket blir det? asks for the total at the till.

rows: äpplen, apelsiner, druvor, ananas, jordgubbar, blåbär, lingon
apples, oranges, grapes, pineapple, strawberries, blueberries, lingonberries
lök, vitlök, potatis, sötpotatis, gurka, morot, kål, blomkål, ingefära
onion, garlic, potato, sweet potato, cucumber, carrot, cabbage, cauliflower, ginger
mjölk, mjöl, ost, svamp, godis, juice
milk, flour, cheese, mushrooms, sweets, juice

sections.memoryTip: No 'of' in Swedish: en påse godis, like Hindi do kilo aloo. Mjöl (flour) has no k; mjölk (milk) has one.
sections.tryIt: Say a four-item picnic list with quantities, then ask what one item costs.

activities.label: Quantity words
activities.title: Match each quantity word to its meaning
activities.instructions: Pair the Swedish with the meaning, then say each one with a food: en burk tomatsås.
activities.pattern: quantity + food, with no word for 'of': en burk tomatsås, ett hekto ost.

activities.label: Ask about the shopping
activities.title: Ask Alex about the picnic shopping
activities.instructions: Choose the question that really gets each fact. Then listen to Alex's answer.

reply.fi: Den kostar fyra euro och femtio cent.

gaps.why: Vad kostar …? asks for a price. Osten is an en-word, so Alex answers with den.

options: Hur många påsar äpplen köper du?
Hur mycket påsar äpplen köper du?
Hur många påsar av äpplen köper du?
gaps.answer: Hur många påsar äpplen köper du?

reply.en: I am buying two bags of apples.

gaps.why: Bags can be counted, so use hur många. Swedish has no av ('of') between påsar and äpplen.
You do not count juice one by one, so use hur mycket (Lecture 7: många for things you count, mycket for things you do not).

reply.fi: Det blir tjugotre euro och femtio cent.
reply.en: That comes to twenty-three euros fifty.

gaps.why: Hur mycket blir det? asks for the total price.

activities.summary: Vad kostar …? for one price, hur många for things you count, hur mycket for amounts and the total.

sections.title: Numbers and order numbers
body: Learn 1-12 as single words. 13-19 end in -ton, like English -teen (tonåring = teenager): tretton, femton, sexton. Tens end in -tio: trettio, femtio, sextio. Watch three odd spellings: 14 fjorton, 18 arton, 40 fyrtio.
In speech, nio and tio often sound like nie and tie, tjugo like tjugi, and fyrtio like förti. Always write the full forms.
Bigger numbers are one word, tens first: 21 tjugoett, 42 fyrtiotvå, 125 hundratjugofem, 1 000 tusen. Before an en-word, 21 can also be tjugoen: tjugoen personer.
An ordinal number gives a place in order: första, andra, tredje. Dates use them: den elfte maj.
For a phone number, one digit at a time is always clear. You will also hear pairs, as in the teacher's example 04 23 78 45: noll fyra, tjugotre, sjuttioåtta, fyrtiofem.

examples.fi: Hur gammal är du? Jag är trettiofyra år.
examples.en: How old are you? I am 34.
examples.note: Jag är trettiofyra år gammal and Jag är trettiofyra are also correct.

examples.fi: Vad är ditt telefonnummer? Mitt nummer är noll fyra noll, ett två tre, fyra fem sex sju.
examples.en: What is your phone number? My number is 040 123 4567.
examples.note: An invented number for speaking practice. Say every digit, including zero.

sections.memoryTip: -ton is a teen, -tio is a ten, -de/-a is an order: fjorton 14, fyrtio 40, fjärde 4th.
sections.tryIt: Say your age, your house number and today's date.

activity.label: Teen, ten or order?
activity.title: Which kind of number is it?
activity.instructions: Listen and look at each word. Is it a teen (13-19), a ten (30-90) or an order number?

items.why: fjorton = 14. The -ton ending makes a teen.
fyrtio = 40, often said förti. The -tio ending makes a ten.
fjärde = 4th, as in den fjärde maj.
sjuttio = 70. Only the ending differs from sjutton.

activity.summary: -ton means 13-19, -tio means 30-90, and -de or -a gives an order number.

sections.title: Present your family
body: Grandparents are built from two words: far (father) or mor (mother) + the person. Farmor is your father's mother, mormor your mother's mother. Hindi makes the same split: dadi and nani.

Aunts and uncles follow the same idea: moster and morbror on your mother's side (Hindi mausi and mama), faster and farbror on your father's side (bua and chacha). Marathi has maushi, mama, atya and kaka. Careful: Hindi mama is an uncle, but Swedish mamma is your mum.
Plurals: bror → bröder, syster → systrar. Syskon means brothers and sisters together. Grandparents in general are far- och morföräldrar.
To say 'no': ingen before an en-word, inget before an ett-word, inga before a plural: Jag har ingen bil, inget husdjur och inga syskon.
Barnfri usually means choosing not to have children; barnlös means without children, often not by choice.

examples.fi: Jag har en syster. Hon heter Priya, är trettio år och bor i Indien.
examples.en: I have a sister. Her name is Priya, she is 30 and lives in India.
examples.note: After the first sentence, hon avoids repeating min syster.

examples.fi: Min moster är ungefär sextio år. Dessutom har hon fyra barnbarn.
examples.en: My aunt (mother's sister) is about sixty. On top of that, she has four grandchildren.
examples.note: Dessutom starts the sentence, so the verb har comes second.

examples.fi: Jag har inga syskon, men jag har många kusiner.
examples.en: I have no siblings, but I have many cousins.

sections.memoryTip: far- = father's side (dadi, bua, chacha); mor- = mother's side (nani, mausi, mama).
sections.tryIt: Present two real or invented relatives in four sentences: relationship, name, age, home.

activity.label: Family links
activity.title: Match the relative to the family link
activity.instructions: Pair each Swedish word with the family link. The Hindi word is there to help you.
activity.pattern: far- = father's side; mor- = mother's side.

sections.title: Clock time and frequency
body: Ask Vad är klockan? Answer Klockan är … Över means past and i means to: tio över fem is 17:10, kvart i sex is 17:45. Prick means exactly.

Halv points to the next hour: halv sex is 5:30. English speakers often say halv fem, thinking of 'half five'. Hindi can help: paune chhe (5:45) already names six; Swedish names the next hour from 5:30.
You will also hear fem i halv sex (17:25) and fem över halv sex (17:35). Timetables use the 24-hour clock: 17.30.

Frequency words say how often: alltid, ofta, ibland, sällan, aldrig. In a statement they come right after the verb: Jag tränar ofta. If one starts the sentence, the verb still comes second: Ibland köper han choklad.

examples.fi: Jag tränar ofta, men jag simmar sällan.
examples.en: I often exercise, but I rarely swim.
examples.note: The frequency word follows the verb.

examples.fi: Ibland handlar jag på Hagnäs torg.
examples.en: Sometimes I shop at Hakaniemi market square.
examples.note: Ibland first, then the verb handlar, then jag.

sections.memoryTip: At :30, name the coming hour: 17:30 = halv sex. And never 'Jag ofta …': the verb comes first, then ofta.

activity.label: Read the clock
activity.title: Match time and Swedish
activity.instructions: Match each digital time to the spoken time.
activity.pattern: över is past; i is to; halv points to the next hour.

sections.title: A short weather report
body: Weather verbs need only det: Det regnar, Det snöar, Det blåser, Det åskar. Do not add är: never Det är regnar.
Describing words need det är: Det är soligt, molnigt, mulet, varmt, kallt. Mulet is a dark grey sky; molnigt is just cloudy. With a noun subject: Solen skiner, Vinden blåser.
Give the temperature with grader: Det är tjugo grader. In a Helsinki winter: Det är minus tio grader.
Use whole chunks for past and future: I går var det kallt. I morgon blir det soligt. The teacher's Det kommer att regna i morgon also means it is going to rain tomorrow.

examples.fi: I dag var det jättevarmt. Det var soligt och ungefär tjugosex grader.
examples.en: Today it was really warm. It was sunny and about 26 degrees.
examples.note: Var is the past of är (Lecture 6).

examples.fi: Det kommer att regna i morgon, och det kommer att blåsa lite.
examples.en: It is going to rain tomorrow, and it is going to be a little windy.
examples.note: Kommer att + verb: what is going to happen.

examples.fi: I Helsingfors är det ofta mulet i november.
examples.en: In Helsinki it is often overcast in November.
examples.note: I Helsingfors starts the sentence, so är comes before det.

sections.memoryTip: Det + verb (Det regnar) or Det är + describing word (Det är soligt). Never both.
sections.tryIt: Look outside and give a three-sentence report with a temperature.

activity.label: Det or det är?
activity.title: Which frame does each weather word need?
activity.instructions: Decide whether the word fits Det ___ or Det är ___.

items.why: Regnar is a verb: Det regnar.
Soligt describes the day: Det är soligt.
Snöar is a verb: Det snöar.
Blåser is a verb: Det blåser.
Mulet describes a dark sky: Det är mulet.
Åskar is a verb: Det åskar.

activity.summary: A weather verb takes Det alone; a describing word takes Det är.

guided.prompt: Choose the correct Swedish for ‘a bag of sweets’.
guided.hint: No word for 'of'; påse is an en-word.
guided.explanation: En påse godis: quantity straight before the food.

guided.prompt: Ask in Swedish: ‘How much does the cheese cost?’
guided.explanation: Vad kostar osten? or Hur mycket kostar osten?

answers: Min syster är fyrtiotvå år gammal.

guided.explanation: Moster is your mother's sister (Hindi mausi). Faster is your father's sister.

guided.hint: Swedish looks toward the next hour.
guided.explanation: 17:30 is halv sex. Halv fem would be 16:30.

guided.prompt: Choose the natural report for rain.
guided.hint: Regnar is a verb, so no är.
guided.explanation: Say Det regnar, not Det är regnar.

guided.hint: Verb first, then ofta: not Jag ofta handlar.
guided.explanation: Jag handlar ofta på lördagar. The frequency word comes after the verb.

missionPlan.title: Plan your family presentation
missionPlan.intro: Use real or invented people. Give a relationship, name, age and place.

words.translation: My maternal grandmother lives in Pune.
In addition I have two cousins.

pronunciation.text: fjorton, fyrtio, sjutton, sjuttio, arton, åttio; kvart över fem, halv sex, kvart i sex
pronunciation.tip: Keep teen -ton separate from tens -tio. Say the clock phrases as whole chunks.

listening.text: Hej Alex, det är Elin. Vi ändrar tiden lite. Picknicken börjar klockan halv tre, inte klockan två. Min syster kommer kvart i tre. Kan du ta med två flaskor vatten också? Det blir ungefär arton grader och växlande molnighet, men det regnar inte. Hej då!
listening.question: What is the new start time?
listening.explanation: Picknicken börjar klockan halv tre: halfway to three, 14:30. Kvart i tre (14:45) is when her sister comes.

reading_passage.text: Hej Elin! Tack för meddelandet. Halv tre passar bra. I dag köpte jag två påsar äpplen, tre hekto ost, tre flaskor juice och två flaskor vatten. Allt kostade tjugotre euro och femtio cent. Men jag glömde att köpa korv, förlåt! Kan du köpa åtta korvar? Prognosen säger att det blir soligt, men det blåser lite. Ta med en tröja! Vi ses på lördag. Alex

options: To accept the new time and report on the shopping
To invite Elin's family to dinner

detail.explanation: Men jag glömde att köpa korv, förlåt!

reading.text: Hej Elin! Tack för meddelandet. Halv tre passar bra. I dag köpte jag två påsar äpplen, tre hekto ost, tre flaskor juice och två flaskor vatten. Allt kostade tjugotre euro och femtio cent. Men jag glömde att köpa korv, förlåt! Kan du köpa åtta korvar? Prognosen säger att det blir soligt, men det blåser lite. Ta med en tröja! Vi ses på lördag. Alex

writing.help: Hej Elin! · Vill du komma på picknick …? · Vi träffas klockan … i Brunnsparken (Kaivopuisto). · Jag tar med … · Kan du ta med …? · Det blir soligt / molnigt / varmt, ungefär … grader. · Vi ses!
writing.model: Hej Elin! Vill du komma på picknick på lördag? Vi träffas klockan två i Brunnsparken. Jag tar med smörgåsar, ett kilo jordgubbar och två flaskor vatten. Kan du ta med juice? Det blir soligt och ungefär tjugo grader, men det blåser lite. Hoppas att du kan komma! Vi ses, Alex

assignment.title: Lecture 10 mission: My family and a picnic
assignment.instructions:
CORE: Present two or three people in your family. Give their names, ages and where they live. Add one thing you often do together.

WRITE: Invite a friend to a picnic. Include day, time, place, food to bring and weather.

RETURN: Present two people from memory in under 30 seconds.
assignment.model: Jag vill berätta om min familj. Mina föräldrar bor i Pune i Indien. Min pappa är sextiotvå år och min mamma är ungefär sextio. Jag har en syster som heter Priya. Hon är trettio år och bor också i Pune. Dessutom har jag en bror som heter Rohan. Han är tjugosju och bor i Mumbai. Vi pratar ofta i telefon.

takeaways: Put the quantity straight before the food, with no 'of': två påsar äpplen, tre hekto ost. Ask Vad kostar …?
-ton is 13-19, -tio is 30-90; ordinal numbers (första, andra) give order and dates.
Present family with relationship, name, age and home: far- is your father's side, mor- your mother's.
Halv sex is 5:30; the frequency word follows the verb; say Det regnar but Det är soligt.
